summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Literacy Training. Learn to interpret data effectively and make informed decisions for your organization’s success.
lede: Data literacy helps professionals interpret data and communicate findings in context. Designed for professionals who manage reporting or use data in departmental decisions, the course develops skills in assessing data quality and preparing datasets for analysis. Learners practice interpreting descriptive and diagnostic statistics and presenting findings through KPI dashboards and data narratives for non-technical stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals who must interpret data, manage reporting workflows, and drive evidence-based strategies within their departments.
modules: Foundations of Data Literacy and Ecosystems
AI Integration and Modern Data Workflows
Data Ethics, Privacy, and Strategic Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of spreadsheet software and an understanding of their department's key performance indicators. No advanced statistical background or programming knowledge is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
